0.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03000_000010_GILGAMESH
0.description: To my side, Enkidu! The battle is joined!

1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03000_000020_GILGAMESH
1.description: Owww! It hurts! It hurts!Enkidu! Your master wants for succor!

3.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03000_000040_GILGAMESH
3.description: This should cut you down to size...

4.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03000_000050_GILGAMESH
4.description: Fight on, Enkidu, my ever faithful─hm!?

5.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03000_000060_GILGAMESH
5.description: Enkidu! Are the bonds of our friendship so fragile!?

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03000_000070_GILGAMESH
6.description: Not the <hex:021A020203>strongest<hex:021A020103> of swords, but it should suffice.

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03000_000080_GILGAMESH
7.description: Gilgamesh is in the mood...for dancing!

10.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03000_000110_GILGAMESH
10.description: What's the matter, friend? All tied up?

11.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03000_000120_GILGAMESH
11.description: Uh-oh! Someone just woke the dragon...

12.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03000_000130_GILGAMESH
12.description: You have some skill, I'll give you that...<hex:02100103>But Gilgamesh has only just begun to fight!

13.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03000_000140_GILGAMESH
13.description: Most impressive!<hex:02100103>Very well─I, too, shall fight with all my strength!

14.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03000_000150_GILGAMESH
14.description: No! The mighty Gilgamesh will not be defeated!

15.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03000_100010_GILGAMESH
15.description: At long last, we meet again on the battlefield!<hex:02100103>I daresay Enkidu shall come to enjoy our tussles as much as I.

16.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03000_100020_GILGAMESH
16.description: <hex:021A020203>You<hex:021A020103>, however, might not find this one so enjoyable.<hex:02100103>...Unless you enjoy getting pounded senseless. Hah!

17.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03000_200010_GILGAMESH
17.description: <hex:021A020203>Me<hex:021A020103>? Run away? Hah! I-I was but seeking out a<hex:02100103>more suitable spot to celebrate my inevitable victory!

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03000_200020_GILGAMESH
18.description: But enough exposition! Now we fight like men!<hex:02100103>And ladies! And ladies who dress like men!

20.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03000_200040_GILGAMESH
20.description: The mightiest warrior ever to grace Eorzea stands before you─<hex:02100103>by which I mean <hex:021A020203>I<hex:021A020103>, Gilgamesh! Prepare yourself!

21.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03000_300010_GILGAMESH
21.description: To think that my full complement of arms would avail me naught...

22.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03000_300020_GILGAMESH
22.description: No more high jinks from Gilgamesh. You have my word.

23.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03000_300030_GILGAMESH
23.description: The Treaty-Blade, too, I shall return.<hex:02100103>...Just as soon as I remember where I hid it.

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03000_300040_GILGAMESH
24.description: Anyway, I yield to your unparalleled puissance!<hex:02100103>Spare my insignificant life, I beg of you!

25.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03000_400010_GILGAMESH
25.description: ...NOT! Ha, I lied...again! Like a rug! Oh, I kill me!

26.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03000_400020_GILGAMESH
26.description: You can take that fusty old blade for all I care! I thirst for <hex:021A020203>true<hex:021A020103><hex:02100103>power, and naught save the strongest of swords will suffice!

27.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03000_400030_GILGAMESH
27.description: Warrior of Light─you have proven a worthy opponent.<hex:02100103>But I warn you─treasure every moment with your weapon.

28.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03000_400040_GILGAMESH
28.description: For as sure as day follows night, the hour will come when<hex:02100103>I claim it as mine own! Till we meet again!
